new_statement: Writing Y=(Y_i) and V=(V_i), rectangular matrix multiplication gives Y^dagger dot V=sum_i Y_i^dagger dot V_i. By validated node 1.3.1, each summand is <Y_i,V_i>*u_Q, so finite distributivity gives Y^dagger dot V=(sum_i <Y_i,V_i>)*u_Q, as also recorded in validated node 1.3.2.2.3. The registered definition column-hilbert-inner-product-displays explicitly fixes the amplified form by <Y,V>_n=sum_i <[Y]_{i1},[V]_{i1}>=sum_i <Y_i,V_i>. Substitution therefore yields Y^dagger dot V=<Y,V>_n*u_Q; suppressing the amplification subscript gives the identity required in node 1.3.2.
